name: @kwonye/mcpx
stderr:
Usage: mcpx [options] [command]

HTTP-first MCP gateway and multi-client installer

Options:
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  add [options] [values...]      Add an upstream MCP server
  remove [options] <name>        Remove an upstream MCP server
  enable [options] <name>        Enable an upstream MCP server
  disable [options] <name>       Disable an upstream MCP server
  list [options]                 List configured upstream MCP servers
  sync [options] [clients...]    Sync gateway configuration to supported clients
                                 (e.g. `mcpx sync claude`)
  status [options]               Show gateway, daemon, MCP inventory, and client
                                 sync status
  doctor [options]               Run local health checks
  daemon                         Manage mcpx local gateway daemon
  secret                         Manage stored secrets
  auth                           Auth utilities
  clients                        Client adapter utilities
  skill                          Manage shared agent skills
  share                          Export and import portable mcpx environments
  plugin-host <plugin> <server>  Run a managed plugin MCP server
  proxy <name>                   Run a stdio MCP proxy bridging to the local
                                 mcpx HTTP gateway for the given upstream server
  mcp                            Compatibility namespace for MCP commands
  update                         Check for and install updates
  project                        Manage project-based MCP configurations
  plugin                         Manage plugins
  telemetry                      Manage anonymous analytics and error reporting
  tui                            Open the integration control center
  harnesses [options]            Inspect harness installations and capabilities
  adopt [options]                Discover, preview, and adopt native
                                 integrations
  activity [options]
  undo <id>                      Undo an operation using its encrypted receipt
  harness-mode <id> <mode>       Set observe, selected, or automatic
                                 synchronization
  help [command]                 display help for command
